info.title: Marque existing marketplace and unsigned procurement contract
info.description: Candidate contract; availability is deployment-dependent. Catalog GET and local pure plan builder do not authorize signing. Quote and intent are explicit offchain side effects; bind and notify require an already-created job. Never preflight arbitrary A2A message/send, invoke a task, accept metadata prices, upload keys, or auto-sign/spend. Runtime checks exceed structural JSON Schema.

400.description: Invalid controlled query; no catalog read

429.description: 120 reads/minute per connection, courtesy in-process limit; no automatic retry

503.description: Read unavailable or HTTP deadline; no SQL details

200.description: Versioned filtered/deduplicated entries, one selected commercial service per entry, UTC provenance and UNKNOWN limits. Cache at most 15 seconds and never past observed quote expiry; stale projection no-store.
Existing exact-service metadata, never a quote or task acceptance

post.description: EXPLICIT OFFCHAIN SIDE EFFECT. Sends negotiate to selected provider and stores observation. 20/min/IP. General outside message/send may cause work: require known provider protocol/consent before invocation. Request quoteAccessVersion:2 to bind later intent access. No automatic client retry; quote expiry is immutable, <=900s. Never call this as catalog preflight.

200.description: Existing PublicQuote: explicit sourceClaimVersion/mode, original quote digest and one-use client access capability. Keep task/capability private.

422.description: Declined, invalid, unsupported or expired; no substitution

post.description: EXPLICIT OFFCHAIN DATABASE WRITE. Existing idempotency key is buyer wallet + original quote ID, serialized under DB advisory lock. Same unbound intent returns same call; expired quote fails, bound intent fails 409. 10/min/wallet and 30/min/IP. No wallet ownership inference from an unsigned address. No onchain write.

200.description: Existing IntentResponse with unsigned createJob arguments; use local HirePlan with independently selected expected terms

409.description: Already bound; recover existing transaction instead of creating again

x-local-hire-plan.recovery: Check existing intent binding and transaction receipt before any retry; confirm new job ID before separate register/budget/exact-approval/fund steps. Pure plan cannot prove an intent unspent.
x-local-hire-plan.quoteSignature: Server-reported mode; no client ECDSA replay from PublicQuote projection. Recheck fresh identity/asset support before signing.

x-read-bounds.cancellation: HTTP timeout does not cancel SQL; statement bounds do not include pool wait. Existing singleflight/SWR retained.
x-read-bounds.rateScope: Courtesy process-local/IP; not distributed or authentication.

x-existing-writers-not-in-client: POST /api/v1/hire/bind records and verifies original user transaction; never creates one
POST /api/v1/hire/notify can trigger paid seller delivery and chain submission; never call as preflight
